name: summarize
summary: Fixed-output deterministic fixture: summarize processed starter note metadata into a deterministic one-line summary.
description: Reference app capability for the traverse-starter multi-capability pipeline showcase (spec 058-workflow-pipeline-execution). Consumes the traverse-starter.process output fields and produces a deterministic summary string plus its word count without model inference. IMPORTANT: this artifact is a fixed-output deterministic fixture -- it does not read or process its input at all; it always returns the same hardcoded summary string and wordCount regardless of the process-output fields provided. It is a genuine, real WASI binary (not a placeholder stub sharing a digest with unrelated capabilities), useful for proving the registry/artifact-hosting/execution pipeline end-to-end, but it does not perform real analysis on its input. Tracked follow-up for real per-input logic: registry#79.

preconditions.description: The caller provides the traverse-starter.process output fields for one note.

postconditions.description: The capability returns a fixed summary string and wordCount, identical for every call regardless of the process-output fields provided.

side_effects.description: Produces a deterministic summary from the provided input.
